description: GVM 800-RGB BLE control traffic between the official iOS app and a light, Scene mode (built-in effects), extracted from an Apple PacketLogger trace (2026-10-30). Only ATT Write Command / Notification payloads on the control characteristic are included; no device addresses or other Bluetooth traffic.

light.protocolAddress: 0x33 (from its handshake reply; the light in capture 1 used 0x30)

captureSequence: connect (light in CCT, scene memory = 1 Lightning)
Custom Colorful Scenes menu, back, Save (no traffic)
